provenance.observation_code: mtd-rl-lag envs/JSBSim/tasks/singlecombat_task.py BaselineAgent.get_observation; training layout envs/JSBSim/tasks/heading_task.py get_obs

description: Low-level aircraft flight controller: a recurrent policy, trained with reinforcement learning (PPO), that directly flies a fixed-wing aircraft. Every control step it reads 12 numbers (a commanded change of altitude, heading and speed, plus the aircraft's own attitude and velocity) and chooses one bin for each of 4 control channels: aileron, elevator, rudder and throttle.

inputs.name: delta_heading
inputs.definition: target heading - current heading, wrapped to (-pi, pi]

notes: Indices 8-10 are body-frame u/v/w (catalog velocities_u/v/w_mps); heading_task.py comments that call them v_north/v_east/v_down are stale.
input_clip [-10, 10] is the training observation_space clip in heading_task.py; BaselineAgent does not clip at inference (values stay well inside the range).
Assumption: baseline_model.pt was trained with the upstream LAG heading_task observation; not verifiable from the repository.

Commands (heading_task / unreach_heading.py: increments up to 7000 ft, 180 deg, 100 m/s; the hierarchical deployment uses +-100 m, +-30 deg, +-17 m/s): delta_altitude +-1 km, delta_heading +-1.5 rad, delta_speed +-68 m/s.

Own state (assumption, from the LAG/MHI scenario configs: start 20000 ft, u 800 ft/s = 244 m/s, altitude_limit 2500 m): altitude 3-8 km, roll +-60 deg, pitch +-30 deg (sampled as angles, written as sin/cos), u 170-306 m/s, v +-10 m/s, w -17..34 m/s, calibrated airspeed 119-272 m/s. Inputs are sampled independently and uniformly, so physically coupled inputs (u vs airspeed, AO vs side) can form off-manifold combinations.
